1_身份与结论.root_reason: 采纳单一跨稿引用限定修正：WP61§3.3将Repel比较者写可战，但同篇可战排濒死，正确WP36及默认配置却选首非蛋可濒死。合法濒死50/后续可战10/野生20默认仍拒绝，不能被更早无可战门排除。只校正WP61括注，保持WP36、计数/续用/雷达/能力/GR011，不强制新增目录测试。
1_身份与结论.history: 原根、别名/撤销和历史资格按完整冻结原记录保留；本任务不增改root分类或旧关闭台账。

2_双向证据.fact_chain: 默认世代8配置按首非蛋成员比较驱虫等级，允许濒死；替代配置才首可战。WP61同文可战明确排濒死，因此该括注与正确WP36不一致。
2_双向证据.raw_tool_evidence: 原提出者/非提出者完整工具定位和范围保留于精确原记录及audit/typed-input-graph.json；私有流不称已公开重放。

3_前提反例及全部路径.contract: 合法首非蛋50级HP0、后续10级健康、野生20级、repel真/雷达假/无相关能力：默认仍按50拒绝并清累积；替代false按10放行。首成员健康50也拒；野生50等于门放行；雷达摇草先放行，nil先拒。无局部取消、拒绝前累积清零不回滚；不改变步进消耗/续用。

facts: allow_encounter? rejects nil, radar shaking grass true bypasses Repel, then supplied repel_active enables comparison.
True configuration chooses first_pokemon (first nonnil non-egg), false first_able_pokemon (also excludes fainted). Fixed generation8 implies true.
Wild candidate level strictly less than chosen level resets chance_accumulator=0 and returns false; equal passes this Repel gate.
Ability INTIMIDATE/KEENEYE is a later separate first_pokemon branch; exclude these abilities in counterexample.
WP61 elsewhere explicitly defines 可战 as nonempty/non-egg/non-fainted; parenthetical can incorrectly narrow receiver despite correctWP36 primary cross-reference.

finite_domain.fixed: R/B8 no plugins, ordinary valid records, no concurrent party mutation
finite_domain.party: P0 non-egg level50 HP0, P1 non-egg level10 HP>0; both valid ordinary non-triggering ability
finite_domain.gates: repel_active=true, radar shaking false, normal callbacks, at least one able member (P1), chosen encounter exists
finite_domain.observation: allow_encounter? return and chance_accumulator only, before generated battle/host presentation

ordinary_control.party: P0 level50 HP>0, P1 level10 HP>0
ordinary_control.expected: first_pokemon and first_able bothP0; accumulator0/false. WP61 shorthand happens to agree.

minimal_counterexample.change: Only P0 HP becomes0, P1 staysable; configuration stays fixedtrue
minimal_counterexample.narrow_reading: Using firstableP1 level10 would make20<10 false, no chosen special ability =>true. This is a paper contrast, no modified R execution.
minimal_counterexample.legal_reachability: Fainted first party with later able ordinary Pokemon is a valid default roster; no illegitimate no-able caller state needed.

negative_evidence.best_rebuttal: This is a parenthetical reference, primary WP36 already correct; 可战 might be read colloquially or referral can control. A nonproposer must decide whether optionalclarification suffices; proposer cannot selfrequired.
negative_evidence.existing_correct_scope: Preserve WP36 correct two-configuration rule and WP61 non-recompute crossreference; no change to allow source, Repel duration/renewal/radar/ability gates.
negative_evidence.not_broadened: No new all-party/index0/egg rule; first non-egg can skip eggs. No allWORLDCRE completion.

acceptance.validation: SOURCE_STATIC / DERIVED_VECTOR / NOT_EXECUTED; later implementation tests separately authorized, not performed here.
acceptance.authoritative_decision: actual different nonproposer full counterreview pending

limits: No wholeWP61 domain certification; allits text read but other source/deepconsumer needed by owning domain

4_最小修订合同.rule: 仅改WP61括注对齐配置及WP36引用；不强制新增目录测试。
4_最小修订合同.preserve: WP36完整两配置、严格小于、雷达/能力顺序、GR011、驱虫计数/续用。

conditional_public_sync.activation: 仅最终整合实际需要对应追溯/索引变动时按每项精确贡献登记，不整表重写；各批不直接写公共层。

criteria: 六个对照返回/清累积准确
默认首非蛋不被写首可战
保留一个正确主合同且不扩范围
5_验收回归.preservation_regression: WP36完整两配置、严格小于、雷达/能力顺序、GR011、驱虫计数/续用。
5_验收回归.no_forced_new_tests: 以各项root最小裁决为准；已有正确目录不因补例有益而强制增加。
